skills.name: repo-map
intents: map repository boundaries, architecture, commands, and task routes
bootstrap layered repository guidance in root and owned subprojects
find reusable contracts and repair durable navigation

skills.name: domain-modeling
intents: resolve shared business vocabulary and meaning
define lifecycle rules and bounded contexts

skills.name: repo-review
intents: review current Worktree or index changes
review a fixed commit, range, or verified package
coordinate correctness, security, performance, and maintainability findings

skills.name: repo-delivery
intents: create categorized or explicitly requested commits
push or integrate a reviewed branch
preserve authorized milestones and clean up Git state

skills.name: product-spec
intents: turn an ambiguous feature into an implementation-ready specification
define product behavior, states, rules, and acceptance

skills.name: ui-spec
intents: translate a selected visual source into an implementation-ready UI contract
maintain traceable feature UI specs and shared DESIGN.md semantics

skills.name: dev-frontend

close selected-source UI differences with runtime validation
change frontend state, data, styling, accessibility, performance, or tooling

skills.name: dev-rust
intents: implement, port, or refactor Rust source
change Rust APIs, services, CLIs, async code, persistence, unsafe, or FFI

skills.name: audit-frontend
intents: audit a bounded frontend surface without editing
assess frontend architecture, accessibility, performance, state, tooling, or visual fidelity

skills.name: audit-rust
intents: audit a bounded Rust workspace or subsystem without editing
assess ownership, concurrency, persistence, performance, or unsafe boundaries

skills.name: ops-browser
intents: operate or verify a specified browser page
capture same-state visual and computed browser evidence

skills.name: ops-client
intents: operate or verify a real desktop client
capture process and window evidence for Tauri, Electron, or native applications

skills.name: ask-chatgpt
intents: prepare a local request package for ChatGPT
run an explicitly authorized independent ChatGPT review, research task, visual exploration, or decision challenge

skills.name: human-writing
intents: draft, rewrite, proofread, diagnose, or adapt source-grounded prose
